summary: Route optional acceleration by workload compatibility, resource policy, correctness, current end-to-end benchmarks, and declared fallback.
enforcement: Keep filesystem, operating-system, ordinary database, serialization, report, and cleanup-safety work on CPU. Select GPU automatically only for compatible batched work with sufficient free VRAM, current correctness evidence, and at least the configured end-to-end speedup. Preserve determinism and precision, use bounded OOM retries, declare CPU fallback, emit routing telemetry, and never transmit local inventory data implicitly.
